Aplique-se para esse desafio e venha fazer parte do nosso time! Junte-se ao Groupe SEB e cresça com a gente!

title: Auxiliar administrativo operacional
description:
Empresa está contratando Auxiliar administrativo operacional em joinville. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

SOBRE NÓS A ZAWA é uma empresa em crescimento contínuo no setor de importação e e-commerce, com atuação consolidada há mais de oito anos nos principais marketplaces do país. Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR e operação logística em Joinville/SC, trabalhamos com processos enxutos e uma estrutura organizacional compacta, composta por equipes de 5 a 10 pessoas. Mantemos o foco na qualidade, na eficiência operacional e na excelência no atendimento ao cliente. Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios: Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais. Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso. Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo. Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes. Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.  SOBRE A VAGA Cargo: Auxiliar Administrativo Operacional Local: Sede operacional – São Marcos, Joinville/SC Tipo de contratação: CLT (presencial) Remuneração: R$ 2.500,00 Carga horária: Segunda a Sexta, das 08h às 17h, com 1h de intervalo Bonificação trimestral por desempenho: R$ 750,00 Bonificação anual por meta da empresa batida: 14o Salário Benefícios: PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual) Vale-refeição (VR): 400,00 mensal Vale-transporte (VT)  ATRIBUIÇÕES O profissional atuará como suporte nas operações diárias da empresa, sendo responsável por garantir a sustentação e a continuidade das rotinas operacionais e administrativas da unidade, transitando entre Logística, SAC e atividades administrativas gerais, garantindo a fluidez da operação, o cumprimento de prazos, a qualidade no atendimento ao cliente e a organização dos processos. Suas responsabilidades incluem: Atendimento ao Cliente (SAC): Apoiar no atendimento a clientes em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon, etc.), Whats App e e-mail; Auxiliar no esclarecimento de dúvidas de pré-venda e pós-venda (produto, instalação, suporte geral); Apoiar nas tratativas de devolução, troca e reembolso conforme política interna; Auxiliar no monitoramento da reputação da marca em marketplaces e plataformas públicas; Apoiar na elaboração e atualização de manuais de uso e instalação de produtos; Auxiliar na produção de materiais explicativos (vídeos, fotos e folders) para redução de erros e dúvidas recorrentes; Processos, indicadores e relatórios: Apoiar na documentação e atualização de processos operacionais (SAC e Logística); Auxiliar na atualização de indicadores nos sistemas internos da empresa; Apoiar na elaboração e alimentação de relatórios operacionais; Operação logística: Apoiar no faturamento de pedidos; Auxiliar na separação, conferência e embalagem (picking & packing); Apoiar na baixa de pedidos nos marketplaces; Auxiliar no acompanhamento de coletas e confirmação de recebimentos; Apoiar na organização e movimentação do estoque (reposição e endereçamento); Auxiliar na realização de inventários periódicos; Apoiar no controle de insumos, embalagens e ativos operacionais; Operações com importação: Auxiliar no recebimento e conferência de cargas importadas; Apoiar no agendamento de coletas; Auxiliar no registro e controle de entrada de importações; Apoiar na emissão de notas fiscais de transferência e reclassificação de mercadorias; Auxiliar na conferência de dados fiscais e operacionais; Abastecimento de estoque fulfillment: Apoiar na preparação de envios para centros de distribuição; Auxiliar na verificação de conformidade com regras dos marketplaces; Apoiar na atualização de status de envio nos canais internos; Compras e suprimentos: Auxiliar na realização de cotações de materiais, serviços e insumos; Apoiar na emissão de pedidos de compra; Auxiliar na atualização do cadastro de fornecedores;  REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÃO Competências obrigatórias: - Ensino Médio completo. - Pacote Office básico. Competências desejadas: - Experiência prévia com operações de e-commerce e atendimento ao cliente; - Experiência com almoxarifado e estoque; - Excel intermediário/avançado; - Conhecimento em sistemas e automações. EXPECTATIVAS O que buscamos: Atenção extrema aos detalhes: identifica erros, confere informações e evita falhas operacionais; Facilidade com sistemas e tecnologia: aprende rápido, navega entre plataformas e valida dados com lógica; Flexibilidade e organização mental: consegue alternar entre diferentes demandas e contextos ao longo do dia sem perder organização ou produtividade; Comprometimento e senso de responsabilidade: cumpre prazos, mantém padrão e entende o impacto do próprio trabalho na operação; Postura ativa na execução: resolve demandas com autonomia, sem depender de direcionamento constante.  O que oferecemos: Treinamento técnico e desenvolvimento pessoal; Direcionamento estratégico; Objetividade na cobrança e feedback; Liberdade com responsabilidade; Sinceridade e transparência.  ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO Triagem de currículos – Análise de perfil profissional. Contato inicial – Esclarecimento de informações e alinhamento de expectativas. Teste avaliativo – Enviado por e-mail aos candidatos selecionados. Entrevista – Avaliação do RH e gestor da área. Feedback e contratação – Formalização da contratação.  Nossa equipe te espera!

description:

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. Qualificações Mínimas • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada. • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas. • Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente). • Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados. • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines. • Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake). • Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados. • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento. • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. • Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis • Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos. • Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning. • Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots). • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. • Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence). • Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

title: Commercial lead — brazil
description:
Empresa está contratando Commercial lead — brazil em mogi guaçu. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Regrow  Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.  About the Role   As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  You will work closely with our Head of Lat Am, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.  This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.  What You’ll Do   Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.  Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.  Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.  Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.  Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.  Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.  Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.  Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    What You’ll Bring   Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2 B environments.  Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.  Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.  Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.  Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or Saa S platforms.  Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.  Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.  Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.  Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.  Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.  Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.    Nice to Have   Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.  Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.  Working knowledge of Spanish.    Why Regrow   Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.  High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.  A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.  Competitive compensation and benefits.      Acerca de Regrow   Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.  Sobre el Rol   Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.  Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de Lat Am, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.  Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.  Qué Harás   Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.  Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.  Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.  Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.  Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.  Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.  Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.  Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Qué Aportarás   Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2 B complejos.  Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.  Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.  Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.  Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas Saa S.  Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.  Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.  Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.  Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.  Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.  Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.    Deseable   Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.  Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.  Conocimiento funcional del español.    Por Qué Regrow   Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.  Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.  Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.  Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Senior backend engineer (node.js) | integração
description:

Descrição da Empresa:  A Carefy é uma plataforma especializada em auditoria para operadoras de planos de saúde, utilizando inteligência artificial para combater fraudes e desperdícios no ciclo de atendimento. Combinamos tecnologia avançada e expertise em fluxos de auditoria para gerar economias significativas para nossos clientes. Somos movidos pelo compromisso de transformar decisões complexas e melhorar a sustentabilidade do setor de saúde. Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance.  Você deverá propor soluções, analisar requisitos técnicos e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar projetos de alto impacto. Atuará como referência técnica, participando diretamente da definição de arquiteturas junto aos times de TI dos clientes e traduzindo desafios complexos em soluções estruturadas para o time interno. Também será responsável por elevar o nível técnico da equipe por meio da definição de padrões de engenharia, disseminação de boas práticas e organização das demandas.  Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

description:

Especialista em Prospecção B2 B (Posição Global) Local: São José dos Campos, SP (Híbrido – Escritório e Home Office) Tipo de Contrato: Prestador de Serviço Independente (PJ) Remuneração em Moeda Estrangeira: Salário base + comissão variável Como se Candidatar Para se juntar a esta jornada, buscamos candidatos comprometidos com a sua própria excelência e a de seus colegas. Siga estas instruções rigorosamente: 1. Envie seu CV (em Inglês) atualizado, incluindo uma Carta de Apresentação (Cover Letter). 2. Envie um vídeo de apresentação (Obrigatório): Duração: 2 a 5 minutos. Idioma: Inteiramente em Inglês. O que abordar: Apresente-se, resuma sua trajetória profissional, compartilhe suas principais características e elabore como você se encaixaria nesta posição e por quê. Preferencialmente, inclua também sua pretensão salarial e qualquer informação adicional que considerar relevante. Certifique-se de deixar o vídeo com acesso aberto para que nossa equipe de recrutamento não tenha problemas de visualização.  Observação: Revisaremos as candidaturas continuamente e preencheremos a vaga assim que encontrarmos o perfil ideal, por isso incentivamos que você se candidate o quanto antes. IMPORTANTE: Esta é uma posição estratégica global. Candidaturas sem o vídeo em inglês serão automaticamente desconsideradas. Sobre o Desafio: Educação e Engajamento Humano Diferente de uma posição de vendas tradicional, o Especialista em Prospecção B2 B na Mag Venture atuará como um embaixador do conhecimento. Sua missão não é vender ou negociar, mas sim educar, qualificar e garantir que a jornada do potencial cliente seja fluida e humana desde o primeiro contato. Este profissional não atuará na subsidiária brasileira, ele fará parte de um hub global operando a partir do Brasil, reportando-se diretamente à nossa matriz na Dinamarca e gerenciando leads de todo o mundo. Nesta função, ele também contribuirá para um propósito maior: expandir o acesso a tecnologias inovadoras para o tratamento de condições de saúde mental, ajudando a trazer um impacto significativo para pacientes e profissionais de saúde em todo o mundo. Responsabilidades Conexão Humana: Engajar leads gerados pelo marketing através de um contato inicial estruturado e genuinamente humano. A comunicação será realizada por meio de campanhas, trocas de e-mails e mensagens (sem contato pessoal direto). Nutrição e Follow-up: Manter um acompanhamento próximo com prospects interessados que ainda não estão no momento de compra. Comunicar-se diretamente com os líderes das subsidiárias globais para desenvolver ações que melhorem a qualidade dos prospects. Educação Consultiva: Fornecer informações e responder a dúvidas técnicas/comerciais sem realizar fechamentos ou negociações. Qualificação de Precisão: Avaliar o timing, o fit cultural/técnico e os sinais de prontidão do prospect antes da passagem de bastão para a equipe de vendas. Inovação em Ações de Qualificação: Sugerir e desenvolver proativamente o uso de eventos online e campanhas multicanais, explorando produtos existentes, lançamentos e materiais, sem se limitar a essas opções. Fluxo no Salesforce: Preservar todo o contexto e histórico do lead no CRM, garantindo que a equipe de vendas receba oportunidades prontas para conversão. Inovação com IA: Trabalhar na exploração de tecnologias de IA e no desenvolvimento de assistentes baseados em GPT para otimizar a produtividade e o engajamento da equipe.  Perfil do Candidato Buscamos um profissional com maturidade para lidar com ciclos de vendas longos e complexos em um ambiente global. Idiomas: Inglês fluente para negócios (essencial para as operações globais diárias). Outros idiomas serão considerados um bom diferencial. Experiência: Mais de 3 anos em B2 B, suporte a vendas, engajamento de clientes ou funções educacionais. Experiência no setor de Saúde ou Med Tech é um diferencial. Ferramentas: Experiência com Salesforce é altamente preferível. Tecnologia & IA: Experiência e/ou curiosidade em criar e "promptar" agentes de IA para otimizar e impulsionar a eficiência. Experiência Global: Vivência prévia em empresas multinacionais e facilidade em trabalhar com diferentes culturas. Disponibilidade: Flexibilidade para viagens internacionais (10 a 20 dias por ano) para Dinamarca, EUA e outros países. Visto americano ativo é um diferencial.  O que Oferecemos Remuneração em Moeda Estrangeira: Salário base fixo + comissão de até 30% do valor base. Principais responsabilidades · Gerenciar e acompanhar a carteira de clientes já existente da empresa. · Manter relacionamento próximo e recorrente com clientes ativos, inativos e em risco. · Identificar oportunidades de cross-sell e up-sell dentro da base atual. · Recuperar clientes que deixaram de comprar, reduziram volume ou estão com baixa movimentação. · Realizar follow-up comercial de propostas, carrinhos abandonados, negociações paradas e oportunidades em aberto. · Conduzir renegociações comerciais, reajustes, renovações e tratativas de retenção. · Mapear necessidades dos clientes e direcionar soluções adequadas ao perfil de cada conta. · Atuar em conjunto com as áreas operacional, financeira, atendimento e gestão para garantir uma boa experiência ao cliente. · Registrar interações, oportunidades e próximos passos no CRM ou sistema definido pela empresa. · Acompanhar indicadores da carteira, como volume de vendas, clientes ativos, clientes reativados, receita recorrente, churn e expansão de contas. · Apoiar a empresa na organização e qualificação da base de clientes. O que esperamos desse profissional · Experiência prévia em vendas consultivas, atendimento comercial, gestão de carteira, customer success ou account management. · Perfil relacional, organizado e orientado a resultado. · Boa capacidade de comunicação, negociação e escuta ativa. · Facilidade para lidar com clientes de diferentes perfis. · Capacidade de entender dores, propor soluções e conduzir conversas comerciais com maturidade. · Disciplina para registrar informações, fazer follow-ups e acompanhar oportunidades até o fechamento. · Visão de longo prazo, com foco em relacionamento, retenção e crescimento da carteira. · Capacidade de trabalhar em conjunto com outras áreas, respeitando processos internos e fluxos definidos. Diferenciais · Experiência com clientes B2 B. · Vivência em empresas de serviços, logística, comércio exterior, consultoria ou atendimento corporativo. · Conhecimento em CRM, funil comercial e indicadores de carteira. · Experiência com recuperação de clientes inativos. · Experiência com renovações, reajustes, contratos recorrentes ou venda de serviços adicionais. · Boa capacidade analítica para interpretar histórico de clientes, volumes, margem e potencial de expansão. Perfil comportamental desejado Buscamos alguém que seja: · Consultivo, e não apenas vendedor. · Organizado, e não apenas comunicativo. · Persistente, mas sem ser invasivo. · Próximo do cliente, mas respeitando os limites da empresa. · Comercialmente ativo, mas com postura profissional. · Capaz de cuidar da relação sem perder o foco em resultado. Este é um perfil para quem gosta de construir relacionamento, entender o cliente, recuperar oportunidades e aumentar o valor da carteira ao longo do tempo. Indicadores de sucesso da função O desempenho poderá ser acompanhado por indicadores como: · Número de clientes ativos na carteira. · Taxa de reativação de clientes inativos. · Receita gerada por cross-sell e up-sell. · Redução de churn ou perda de clientes. · Volume de oportunidades recuperadas. · Taxa de conversão de propostas em aberto. · Frequência e qualidade dos follow-ups. · Atualização correta do CRM. · Crescimento da receita dentro da base atual. · Nível de satisfação e relacionamento com clientes. title: Director, fp&a – people costs
description:
Empresa está contratando Director, fp&a – people costs em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hunter Douglas is the world's leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we've defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally. We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What's yours? Position Overview The Director, FP& A – People Costs is a critical strategic partner to the CHRO, responsible for driving financial rigor, transparency, and forward-looking insights across all People Costs globally. This role will lead analysis, planning, forecasting, and process excellence for People Costs, while partnering closely with HR Zone Leaders, Finance, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure costs are well-managed, benchmarked, and aligned with business priorities. This is an early-career Director role, ideal for a high-performing Senior Manager ready to step into a broader enterprise-level leadership position with significant visibility and impact. Key Responsibilities 1. Monthly People Cost Performance & Forecasting (Primary Accountability) Lead the monthly analysis of People Costs across all zones, including actuals vs. budget, trend analysis, and forward-looking forecasts. Partner closely with HR Zone Leaders to: Identify drivers of performance and variances. Surface risks and opportunities to return to or beat plan. Diagnose top People Cost issues and facilitate structured problem-solving discussions. Ensure clear ownership of actions and follow-through. Leverage Zero-Based Organization (ZBO) analysis and external benchmarks to: Assess performance versus standards and peers. Identify structural cost opportunities and productivity improvements. Synthesize insights into clear, compelling executive-level narratives, not just reports.  2. Lead the Global People Cost Budget & Planning Process Own and lead the end-to-end People Cost budget process, delivering a high-quality consolidated plan to Global FP& A. Establish and maintain: Budgeting templates. Planning assumptions and guidance. Analytical frameworks to ensure consistency and comparability across zones. Partner with HR and Finance leaders in each zone to ensure: Timely submission of plans. High-quality, well-reasoned inputs. Clear articulation of levers to achieve or exceed plan. Analyze the consolidated plan to identify: Key risks and opportunities. Cost levers and trade-offs. Scenarios to support decision-making.  3. Build and Implement a Scalable People Cost Management Process Design and implement a standardized, end-to-end People Cost management process, integrating: Budgeting Monthly results Forecasting Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate reporting and analysis. Partner cross-functionally with: Finance HR Zone Leaders Data Scientists / Analytics teams Drive adoption of new tools, dashboards, and ways of working that improve insight, speed, and decision quality.  4. Strategic Project Management (Approx. 25% of Role) Support the CHRO by project managing high-priority, non-People Cost initiatives, acting as a trusted thought partner and execution leader. Responsibilities may include: Structuring complex initiatives. Developing workplans, milestones, and tracking mechanisms. Driving cross-functional alignment and accountability. Preparing executive-level materials and updates. This aspect of the role provides exposure to enterprise-wide priorities and senior leadership.  Critical Capabilities & Skills Advanced data analytics and financial modeling skills, with the ability to translate data into insights. Strong problem-solving mindset; comfortable working through ambiguity and complexity. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, particularly in executive presentations. Ability to influence without authority and work effectively across geographies and functions. High learning agility, ownership mindset, and bias for action. Comfortable operating at both strategic and detailed levels.  Experience & Profile 8–12 years of experience in FP& A, finance, strategy, or related analytical roles. Currently a Senior Manager or equivalent, ready for a first Director role. Experience partnering closely with senior leaders (HR or functional leadership exposure strongly preferred). Background in budgeting, forecasting, and performance management in a complex, multi-geography organization. Experience with ZBO, cost transformation, or productivity programs is a strong plus.  Why This Role High visibility and direct partnership with the CHRO. Opportunity to shape how People Costs are managed globally. Exposure to enterprise-level decision-making and transformation initiatives. Clear runway for growth and expanded leadership responsibility.  What's in it for you Generous benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability A company culture that prioritizes transparency, entrepreneurship, accountability, meritocracy and one team Time off with pay 401(k) plan with a degree of employer matching Paid parental leave Wellness programs and product discounts  Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate's education, experience, skills and potential. Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws.

Empresa está contratando Educational project service leader em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Open English has been a leader in English language teaching through virtual classes for over 15 years. We are proud to be a global and digital education (Ed Tech) the leading English-learning platform in over 30 markets, including Latin America, Brazil, the U. S. Hispanic market, Turkey, and Spain, among others. With over 3 million students enrolled to date, Open English is transforming the traditional language-learning model through its proprietary technology platform, offering unlimited, 24/7 access to live online classes with native-speaking instructors. The company provides tailored solutions for individuals, businesses (Open English Business), and children (Open English Junior). It has also expanded its offering to include French, Italian, and Portuguese programs through Open Mundo. Backed by over $150 million in venture capital from top-tier firms such as Insight Partners and TCV, Open English continues to scale globally following its acquisitions of English Ninjas in Turkey and Enguru in India. The company is headquartered in Miami, with offices across Mexico City, Bogotá, Buenos Aires, Istanbul, Bangalore, and São Paulo. We invite you to join us and be part of an innovative team dedicated to empowering our students. We are constantly seeking the best professionals in their fields to join our team. We offer the opportunity to work together and implement new ideas in a joyful and inspiring work environment. Position Overview We are looking for an Educational Project Service Leader who will play a key end-to-end role in the delivery of our educational projects, from implementation through renewal. As a key success driver within each initiative, and operating within our B2 G (Business to Government) structure, this role is responsible for the day-to-day leadership, execution, and performance of assigned projects. You will be accountable for ensuring that each project meets its defined objectives and KPIs, proactively designing and executing strategies to drive performance, adoption, and partner satisfaction. In close collaboration with the Customer Service team, you will lead initiatives that enhance student engagement and deliver an exceptional service experience. As the main operational point of contact for partners, you will lead project execution, align cross-functional teams, anticipate risks, and identify opportunities for growth and renewal. Success in this role requires a strong balance of project ownership, stakeholder management, and data-driven decision-making. This role also requires availability for occasional national and international travel to strengthen partner relationships and support the execution of key initiatives. Project Ownership & Execution: Own the end-to-end execution and performance of assigned educational projects, ensuring successful implementation, delivery, and renewal. Drive day-to-day operations, track progress against milestones, and proactively address risks and blockers. Partner Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Work closely with the account owner and key partner stakeholders to ensure alignment on project goals, expectations, and performance. Support partner interactions by providing operational insights, updates, and solutions that strengthen the overall relationship. Performance Management & Strategy: Own project performance against defined KPIs, continuously monitoring results and identifying gaps. Design and execute data-driven strategies to improve adoption, engagement, and overall project outcomes. Student Engagement & Service Excellence: Partner closely with the Customer Service team to develop and implement initiatives that enhance student engagement and ensure a high-quality, consistent service experience. Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead coordination across internal teams (Product, Operations, Content, Legal, etc.) to ensure alignment, timely execution, and successful delivery of project requirements and new initiatives. Process Optimization & Scalability: Continuously evaluate and improve workflows, tools, and processes to increase efficiency, scalability, and quality in project execution. Risk Management & Continuous Improvement: Anticipate potential challenges, identify root causes of issues, and implement proactive solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on insights, feedback, and performance trends. Reporting & Insights: Track, analyze, and report on key performance metrics, providing actionable insights to the account owner, partner stakeholders, and internal leadership to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments. Must-Have Skills & Qualifications Project management experience: Proven track record managing end-to-end project execution, including timelines, delivery, and milestones. KPI & performance ownership: Experience tracking and delivering results against KPIs, using data to drive decisions and improvements. Stakeholder & cross-functional collaboration: Experience working with multiple internal teams and supporting external stakeholders in coordination with an account owner or manager. Global & cross-cultural collaboration: Experience working in multicultural environments, with the ability to collaborate effectively across regions, cultures, and time zones. Customer/student engagement focus: Experience driving adoption, engagement, or satisfaction in service-based or educational environments. Analytical & problem-solving skills: Ability to identify performance gaps and implement effective, data-driven solutions. Strong communication skills: Ability to clearly convey updates, insights, and recommendations to different audiences. Operational & process improvement mindset: Experience optimizing workflows and improving execution efficiency. Tech proficiency: Experience with CRM, project management, and reporting tools (e. G., Salesforce, Zendesk, Asana, Excel/Sheets). English proficiency (B2 or higher) Availability to travel  Preferred Experience Experience in B2 G or public sector projects: Exposure to working with government entities, public institutions, or large-scale educational programs. Background in Ed Tech or education programs: Experience managing or supporting educational initiatives, digital learning platforms, or student-focused services. Experience in scalable or multi-project environments: Familiarity working in environments where multiple projects run simultaneously under shared structures or leadership. Advanced data analysis & reporting: Experience using dashboards, BI tools (e. G., Tableau, Power BI), or advanced Excel/Sheets to generate insights and drive decisions. Process design & standardization: Experience building or standardizing processes that can be replicated across projects or teams. Indirect leadership experience: Experience mentoring, coaching, or influencing team members without direct reporting lines. Experience working in global organizations: Exposure to distributed teams, regional coordination, or international project environments.

title: Global compliance manager - bioenergy
description:
Confira a vaga para Global compliance manager - bioenergy em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Nufarm. Evolving Ag. Nufarm is a global crop protection and seed technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and fuel production. Whether it's commercialising the world's first plant-based omega-3, launching precision agricultural solutions, unlocking biomass oils for more sustainable fuels and fast-moving consumer goods, launching innovative new crop protection solutions or delivering the crop and seed solutions farmers depend on every day, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to drive value for customers. Your Future, Fuelled by Innovation The Global Compliance Lead, Bioenergy Assurance is responsible for the effective execution of Nufarm's global Assurance Program and related compliance systems. The role leads global certification and audit direction, works closely with regional teams to achieve and maintain 100% certification readiness and compliance, and broadens program oversight beyond certification to include legal, environmental, social, traceability, and internal policy requirements. This position also oversees internal assessment of centrally managed global processes - including GHG tool governance, methodology determination, risk management, and related controls - to identify gaps, drive corrective actions, and strengthen end-to-end assurance performance across the business. How You'll Help Us Grow Lead global certification and audit direction across the Assurance Program, including coordination with certification bodies, auditors, and regional teams. Monitor and collaborate with relevant global certification schemes to maintain Nufarm's leadership and competitive position. Own interpretation and implementation guidance for certification requirements, standards, procedures, and related external scheme updates. Drive certification readiness and performance across regions to achieve and maintain 100% certification compliance. Oversee certification program deployment and implementation for new countries, processors, value chain partners, and applicable carbon-credit or market requirements. Support and provide oversight across the internal audit program(s) for regional assurance activities, ensuring audits are completed well, correctly, and comprehensively. This role is not responsible for regional program implementation. Conduct internal assessment or audit of centrally managed global processes owned by the global team, potentially including GHG tool modelling and development, methodology determination, documentation controls, and risk management processes. Identify control gaps, process weaknesses, and compliance risks across legal, environmental, social, and internal requirements. Verify that centrally managed processes are documented, version-controlled, implemented consistently, and supported by appropriate evidence. Facilitate or oversee risk identification, risk assessment, risk management, and risk monitoring activities required under the Assurance Program and associated standards. Contribute to updates to global certification documentation, audit tools, SOPs, work instructions, and related compliance materials. Partner with program management, data/IT, and regional teams to strengthen systems, reporting, and process design for ongoing program improvement. Review regional audit outputs, supporting evidence, and corrective action plans; escalate and ensure closure of significant non-compliances as appropriate. Monitor regional execution of land use verification, traceability, mass balance, UDB-related direction, training, and documentation expectations. Assess regional capability and provide coaching, training, and tools to improve audit quality and consistency. Build trusted working relationships across regions and functions to align expectations, remove barriers, and reinforce accountability. Provide leadership, mentoring, and development for any direct reports and strong matrix leadership for regional assurance personnel. Support training, communication, and change management efforts related to certification, compliance, and assurance.  If you want to be a part of a thriving, supportive environment and are inspired by the prospect of being a part of something bigger, we'd love to hear from you. Nufarm is proud to be recognised as an endorsed top 10 employer of choice for all women by WORK180. A note to recruitment agencies - we have this role covered. There is no need to get in touch, we do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior backend engineer (golang) em atibaia. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:

Role Overview:   As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM. Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing) em sapiranga. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses). The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.  The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.  Financial   ● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.  ● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.  ● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates  ● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.  ● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients  ● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients  ● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions  Operational   ● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.  ● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.  ● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.  ● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.  Experience and Skills   ● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.  ● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance  ● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.  ● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.  ● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus  ● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.  ● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Artificial intelligence engineer em sumaré. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Title:  AI Engineer  Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.” Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  .   Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Senior backend engineer (golang)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior backend engineer (golang) em jaguariúna. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA  Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations  Company:  Fulcrum Saa S  Location:  Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:  Full-time  Level:  Senior / Staff  Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location  About Fulcrum Saa S   Fulcrum Saa S is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant Saa S environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.  Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, Big Query, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.  The Role   We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.  You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.  You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.  What You’ll Do   Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.  Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.  Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/Big Query or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.  Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.  Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.  Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.  Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.    What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)  5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).  Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.  Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.  Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/Big Query strongly preferred; Cassandra, Dynamo DB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.  Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.  Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.  Multi-tenant Saa S experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.  Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.  Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.  Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).    Strong Nice-to-Haves   Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).  A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.  Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.  Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.    What We Offer   Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.  Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.  Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.  A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.    How to Apply   Please apply through Linked In with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:  Your experience with Go in production.  The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.  Your country of residence and preferred start date.    You can also include links to Git Hub, technical blogs, or talks if available.
